name: Loyal
overview: Scripture reveals that loyalty is demonstrated through wholehearted commitment to God and His commands, as believers are called to serve Him sincerely rather than men (Colossians 3:23). True loyalty involves standing firm against spiritual opposition by putting on the full armor of God (Ephesians 6:11) and persevering in faith and obedience, reflecting the patience of the saints who keep God's commandments and the faith of Jesus (Revelation 14:12). This steadfastness is grounded in the eternal value of the soul, reminding believers that gaining the world is worthless if it costs one's soul (Matthew 16:26), and is connected to the blessing promised to those who align themselves with God's purposes (Genesis 12:3).
